items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: She was going with Eddie Mallory then, you know.

ctx.x: But me and her was like that. Great. She was going with Eddie Mallory then, you know. Very hard to get along with. She didn't take no back -- took off of nobody. I got along good with her because when she started to get tight with me, I would dummy up on her and not say nothing. In the songs, when she was going to say -- I'd say nothing. It would break her heart. 'Why do you talk to them?' I'd say, 'Well, I didn't figure you was talking to me.' Then we'd go right back, catch up, that money going right on.
She was beautiful. But you had to know how --
